# Camp: Weather Control Station - Fireworks

Get your C.A.M.P. ready to party with the Weather Control Station (Fireworks).

Weather Control Station will change weather in the C.A.M.P. radius when connected to power.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Fireworks Weather Station__

**Produces**

Fireworks

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

All other Weather Control Stations

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Appliances

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Weather Control Station (Fireworks) - 1400 atoms (TBC)

Atom Shop - Bundle - X atoms

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

2 Power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
